effect_description_eng:
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent plays a Digimon or Tamer, by trashing 1 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] When this card is trashed from digivolution cards by an effect, gain 1 memory.
